name: neobrutalism-checkboxes
title: Checkboxes
description: Neobrutalism-style checkbox components built with Tailwind CSS. Featuring thick borders, hard shadows, and custom check marks. Perfect for forms, filters, and settings requiring a bold, retro interactive element.
useWhen: Allowing independent selections in a form, filter, or settings interface with a bold visual treatment.
Presenting a compact list of options that can be checked in any combination.
avoidWhen: Choices are mutually exclusive — use radio buttons.
The choice has more than two or three distinct states.
responsiveBehavior: Checkbox rows retain a generous target area and wrap labels beneath controls when needed. Grouped choices stack vertically on narrow screens.
accessibility: Use native checkbox inputs and associate each with a visible label.
Wrap related choices in a fieldset with a legend.
